title: Reimagine the Internal Trigger
coreMove: Rewrite the story attached to a bad feeling so it becomes information to work with, not an order to escape.
sourcePressure: The chapter deepens the internal-trigger work by changing the meaning assigned to discomfort rather than pretending discomfort should vanish.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: A weak run would ask the reader to put a positive spin on discomfort instead of changing the story that gives the feeling control.

hook: Reimagine the Internal Trigger as a labeled topic opener
counterintuition: phones are not the problem by itself
tryThisNow: set a timer and notice your distractions
examples: reused old-package object-anchor shell from earlier Indistractable run

exampleSpecs.domain: patent illustrator staring at rejected drawing notes
exampleSpecs.audience: illustrator who reads criticism as proof of incompetence
exampleSpecs.stakes: a client filing stalls because shame becomes browsing
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: before, she sees rejection; after, she writes the note as a map for the next figure and reopens the grid
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A translucent drafting overlay covers a rejected patent figure.

exampleSpecs.domain: ferry captain trainee studying collision rules
exampleSpecs.audience: trainee who hears confusion as evidence she is not built for command
exampleSpecs.stakes: licensing prep gets replaced by harbor gossip
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she changes 'I am bad at this' into 'this is the rule set that needs another pass' and restarts the chart exercise
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A tide chart is pinned beside a collision-rules card.

exampleSpecs.domain: bakery wholesale rep after a rejected account call
exampleSpecs.audience: sales rep who turns disappointment into online wandering
exampleSpecs.stakes: a neighborhood route loses momentum after one no
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he says the sting means the pitch found a weak spot, then revises one sample offer
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A sample invoice lies beside a torn bakery route sheet.

exampleSpecs.audience: manager tempted to avoid inspection because loss feels personal
exampleSpecs.stakes: sorting choices worsen if the feeling means failure
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she renames dread as a signal to separate saleable bins first and walks the first row
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A hail-dented apple sits on a sorting scale.

exampleSpecs.domain: public defender reading a hostile judge's order
exampleSpecs.audience: attorney who interprets anger as futility
exampleSpecs.stakes: the next filing needs precision, not escape
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he writes 'anger means find the narrow opening' and highlights the one procedural line
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A court order is clipped beneath a blue appeal tab.

exampleSpecs.domain: ceramics studio owner after a kiln firing fails
exampleSpecs.audience: artist who treats a cracked batch as proof she should stop
exampleSpecs.stakes: a commission deadline tightens while self-judgment takes over
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she labels the crack pattern as information and marks the next temperature ramp
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A cracked porcelain bowl rests beside a kiln log.

skillTargets: identify when a scenario calls for: Rewrite the story attached to a bad feeling so it becomes information to work with, not an order to escape.
choose the action that stays inside Reimagine the Internal Trigger's source pressure rather than adjacent productivity advice
explain why the tempting weak version fails: A weak run would ask the reader to put a positive spin on discomfort instead of changing the story that gives the feeling control.
use chapter-specific terms such as reimagine, internal trigger, interpretation, meaning in transfer scenarios

tryThisNowSpec: Write one sentence that starts 'This feeling is a signal that...' and finish it with a useful next action instead of a judgment.
